chapter_title: The Chapter on whether any [Lig]ht comes from the

fills.notes: Opening formula to set a conditional rule; fits impersonal, schematic substrate style and prepares the concessive “but should … ascend …” construction.

The whole passage tracks rays entering “great open gates … door … firmament by firmament”; the correspondential target of the gates is the receptacles below each firmament. This also aligns with ¶3’s explicit “opening downwards to the vessels.”
Needed to complete the motion-sequence: ascent from the lower vessels toward the gates, then entry of rays through gates/doors. Keeps the mechanical-cosmological register.

Balances the clause: rays “which are received … shine and go in through these great open gates”; the gates/doors belong to the upper boundary of each firmament, so “are above” fits the spatial correspondence.

The “little pillar” here is the remnant-accumulation/concentration of light in the lower place that the rays ‘pull through’ the openings. Adding “of light” makes the referent explicit and preserves the substrate’s physicalized cosmology (light as a substance/portion).

After being “poured out to the firmaments,” the required next operation is separation/filtration in stages (“firmament by firmament”). “Clarified” already appears; pairing with “sifted” tightens the correspondential idea of discriminating pure light from mixed residue across discrete degrees.

The antithesis demands a remainder that cannot be taken up “with the living ones.” In the substrate logic, purification yields two outputs: a cleansed portion taken upward, and a mixed/heavy remainder (“dregs”) expelled downward.

assessment: Most gaps can be restored at the level of cosmological operations (reception of rays, entry through gates, extraction of a concentrated ‘pillar’ of light, staged clarification, and a twofold outcome: uplift vs. downward expulsion). Exact connective particles in ¶2 and the precise phrasing of the transition in ¶4 remain less tight because the surviving syntax is thin, but the correspondential sequence (lower vessels → gates/doors → firmaments → separation) constrains the restorations strongly.
